QuestionStmt.S: 4 gram of NaOH is added in water to form 500 mL solution at 298 K. What is pH of solution? (Molar mass of NaOH = 40 g mol⁻¹)

Solution.S:
Given:
Mass of NaOH = 4 g
Volume of solution = 500 mL = 0.5 L
Molar mass of NaOH = 40 g/mol

Step 1: Moles of NaOH = 4 / 40 = 0.1 mol

Step 2: Molarity = 0.1 / 0.5 = 0.2 M

Step 3: [OH⁻] = 0.2 M (strong base, complete dissociation)

Step 4: pOH = -log[OH⁻] = -log(0.2) = -log(2 × 10⁻¹) = -(log 2 - 1) = 1 - log 2 = 1 - 0.3010 = 0.6990

Step 5: pH = 14 - pOH = 14 - 0.6990 = 13.3010

Thus the correct option is D: 13.3010.
